scope: Selected major US residential providers; not a market-share ranking. Choose the provider for the affected circuit. Business agreements require their own contact and terms.

providers.name: Xfinity
providers.guidance: Use the account support outage and credit workflow; eligibility is evaluated by Xfinity.

providers.name: Spectrum
providers.guidance: Contact support with the incident details and ask for assessment under the current Customer Commitment.

providers.name: AT&T Internet
providers.guidance: Select Internet support. The AT&T Guarantee covers qualifying services and interruptions with exclusions; verify your plan and any proactive credit first.

providers.name: Verizon Fios / Home Internet
providers.guidance: Select the affected home service. Ask support to confirm the outage and applicable adjustment terms.

providers.name: T-Mobile Home Internet
providers.guidance: Use Home Internet technical support, not the sales team. Request a ticket and review of any applicable service adjustment.

providers.name: Cox / Spectrum transition
providers.guidance: The official Cox contact page now identifies the Spectrum transition. Use the support route for your existing account and verify its applicable terms.

providers.name: Frontier
providers.guidance: Open a technical support case and ask customer service to review an adjustment for the recorded interruption.

providers.name: Optimum
providers.guidance: Use the support channel for your account and region. Ask for an incident reference and billing review.

providers.name: Quantum Fiber
providers.guidance: Use the Customer Success team for connection and account questions. Request a review under your service terms.

providers.name: CenturyLink
providers.channel: Account and technical support chat / phone
providers.guidance: Choose account and technical support for your region. Ask for a trouble ticket and applicable credit review.

providers.name: GFiber / Google Fiber
providers.channel: Official support email option / chat / phone
providers.guidance: Use Email Us or the live support options on the official help page. Obtain the destination there; no public mailbox is assumed.

providers.name: Starlink
providers.guidance: Use the account or app support ticket workflow. Follow up on an existing ticket for the same unresolved incident.
